title: Research Officer at Ayush Research Councils

value.body: The Ministry of Ayush runs four autonomous research councils — CCRAS (Ayurveda), CCRH (Homoeopathy), CCRS (Siddha) and CCRUM (Unani Medicine). Research Officers in these councils run clinical studies, drug standardisation and literary research, and staff the councils' research institutes and units across India.

items.label: Councils
items.note: Autonomous bodies under the Ministry of Ayush

items.label: Usual qualification
items.value: PG degree (MD/MS) in the system + registration
items.note: Registration with the central or state register for that system

items.label: Pay level
items.value: Level 10, 7th CPC pay matrix (+ NPA as applicable)

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Each council issues its own recruitment notification when posts are open. Selection has typically been a written test followed by an interview. A postgraduate degree in the relevant system (for example MD Ayurveda for CCRAS) is usually essential, so a BAMS/BHMS/BSMS/BUMS graduate normally completes an MD first via AIAPGET.

value.title: At a glance
items: Recruitment is irregular and the number of posts per system is small.
Age limits (around 40 years in recent CCRAS notices) and pay vary by notification — check the current one.
The work is research-oriented: protocols, data, publications — not mainly private clinical practice.
